sentence: This project studies how a protein called caspase-11 helps immune cells called macrophages clear Legionella bacteria.
This project studies cardiac ion channels and tries to build an approach for improving heart function.
This project offers gene screening, DNA sequencing and other genomics tools to support cancer research.
This project studies how hypoxia signaling and circadian rhythm pathways interact in heart muscle injury after blocked blood flow.
This project studies how the autonomic nervous system controls muscle stem cells during aging.
This project studies how innate lymphoid cells and innate-like T cells respond to Staphylococcus infections in newborn tissues.
This project holds a conference on signaling pathways that guide tissue development and drive disease when they fail.
This project builds a model of aged tissue from engineered human tissue and a mouse to study how aging affects disease.
This project builds ultrasound methods that image brain circuits and target several places in them at once in real time.
This project studies how receptors, channels and G proteins form one complex that carries inhibitory signals in neurons.
This project studies proteins in the blood to see how blood pressure rises with exercise and with age.
This project offers imaging tools to follow tumor growth, spread and treatment response in animals.
This project studies how vocal fold vibration relates to how voice quality sounds in connected speech, using imaging and computer models.
This project uses hyperpolarized probes to image the metabolism of glioma tumor cells and find early signs of treatment response.
This project maps molecules in kidney biopsies from people with acute or chronic kidney disease using imaging mass spectrometry and microscopy.
This project studies how molecules bind and control N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor channels in the brain.
This project develops hyperpolarized probes and methods, and tests them in preclinical models, to improve imaging.
This project screens small molecules, with lab tests and computer models, to find ones that act on the airway in constrictive airway diseases.
This project maps the genes and cells linked to different types of pain in human peripheral nerves and spinal cord.
This project studies the molecular causes of congenital dyserythropoietic anemias, disorders that disrupt red blood cell production.
